newsitem.title: INDIA: Delhi shares end lower ahead of settlement.
newsitem.headline: Delhi shares end lower ahead of settlement.

text.p: Delhi shares ran out of steam on Thursday after a three-day rally and closed marginally lower on selling ahead of the end of settlement, brokers said.
The bourse's benchmark index closed 1.99 points lower at 809.48 points. Friday is the last day of the current settlement period.
"The speculators, who had built large positions, were seen selling ahead of tomorrow's fortnightly settlement," said Bharat Bhushan of brokers Nu Era Equities.
But other brokers said prices remained on a fundamentally upward trend.

"Despite the partial drop in stock values, the sentiment seems to be bullish as the foreign investors have been making purchases in index-linked shares and might extend their buying to other shares," said another broker.
Hindustan Lever, which had surged in the past few sessions, dropped 7.00 rupees to 1,230.00 on profit-taking by speculators, brokers said.
State Bank of India dropped 2.55 rupees to 319.00.
